narrative.details: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until. . .the incident.  After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn.  There was an Insane Ghoul who used to roam back there.  Perhaps he picked it up.  Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.
narrative.objectives: Retrieve Blind Mary's Looking Glass from the Insane Ghoul and give it to Viktori in Darkshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: Most superb! This will work perfectly. Many thanks!
narrative.requestItemsText: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine. He was impressed. Did you happen to find a reflective device?
